name: @equin/plugin-plugin-meta-plugin-records-key-width
description: How much of a record producer's key is code it never calls: keyWidths walks a producer's closure through the names it actually imports from each barrel and attributes the rest to the barrel imports that drag it in; describeWideKeys fails producers over MAX_UNUSED_KEY_MODULES. Run by the producers' owners' checks (file scans, facets), never in the build path.
